task_text: Explore the underground cave room and find the emerald ore block. Look carefully at the stone formations for the distinctive green-speckled emerald ore texture.
design_notes: The emerald ore is at ~4 ~1 ~6 (spawn-relative), placed on the western face of a stone formation (fill ~4-6, ~0-2, ~5-7). The setblock command runs AFTER the fill, replacing one stone block with emerald ore so its west face is exposed to the room interior. Three glowstone blocks at floor level ensure the room is well-lit. The room is fully enclosed with stone brick walls and a stone ceiling to simulate an underground cave. Stone formations and a cobblestone structure add visual complexity requiring exploration.
